goal: The Sasquatch Inn has been on the Lougheed Highway for 72 years, and the last three years of renovation have turned it into a place people plan around, not just pull over for. The proof is in the numbers: 1,735 Google reviews at 4.3 stars that Nancy never had to chase, a Facebook following of 6,000, and events like Season of the Wild that sell out every year. The gap is not the business. The gap is that Google shows three businesses with three different sets of hours as one listing, the website is missing the basic search signals the digital assessment flagged, and social posting happens about once a week when the platforms reward a lot more than that. The next ninety days fix those three things in order. Nancy leaves on November 16 for three weeks, so the plan front-loads the heavy setup into the first two weeks and uses scheduled content and a helper to keep everything moving while she is away. By the end, the pub, the hotel, and the liquor store each have their own accurate Google listing, the website answers the questions travellers and AI tools are asking, and more hotel guests are booking direct instead of through Booking.com.
